name: Turtle-style crypto system: 20-day high entry, 10-day low exit, 2N stop (hourly execution)
author: pplonski
license: Source terms apply; paraphrased summary only
instruments_timeframes: BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT daily levels with hourly execution (Binance data in repo).
indicators: Donchian high(20)/low(10) on daily bars, N (ATR 20)
entry_long: Daily 20-day highest high (prior days, shifted 1) = upper bound. Evaluated on hourly bars: if the previous hourly close > upper bound and no position, buy all capital at the average of the bar open and close.
exit: Sell when the previous hourly close < the 10-day lowest low (lower bound, shifted 1) or previous hourly close < stop; stop = entry price - 2 x N, N = 20-day Wilder-smoothed true range (N_t = (19 N_{t-1} + TR_t)/20).
position_sizing: All-in single position; fees 0.1% per side (backtest default); no Turtle unit pyramiding.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Long-only simplification of Turtle System 1 without the skip-last-winner filter or pyramiding; levels computed on daily bars, signals on hourly closes.
